matches_finished_has_score.name: matches_finished_has_score
matches_finished_has_score.value: "matches"."status" <> 'finished' or ("matches"."goals_for" is not null and "matches"."goals_against" is not null)

ps_shots_consistent.name: ps_shots_consistent
ps_shots_consistent.value: "player_statistics"."shots" is null or "player_statistics"."shots_on_target" is null or "player_statistics"."shots_on_target" <= "player_statistics"."shots"

ps_passes_consistent.name: ps_passes_consistent
ps_passes_consistent.value: "player_statistics"."passes_attempted" is null or "player_statistics"."passes_completed" is null or "player_statistics"."passes_completed" <= "player_statistics"."passes_attempted"
